Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class MBScenarios

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.MBScenarios
final class MBScenarios extends Object
Cross-loader Mob Bucket scenarios; each loader wraps every method as a GameTest. Captures are a player's right-click on the mob (GameTestSupport.interactWithEntity(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand)); releases are a sneaking player's right-click on the side of CLICKED (SharedGameTestSupport.clickBlock(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult)).
